div.div: 4 اشمتهُ ٱللّٰهُ بِهِ God made him (i. e. the enemy, A, Msb) to rejoice at his affliction. (A, * Msb, K, TA.) For فَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِىَ ٱلْأَعَدَآءَ [Therefore make not thou the enemies to rejoice at my affliction], in the Kur [vii. 149], Mujáhid is related to have read ↓ فلا تُشَمِّتْ : but the correctness of this is doubted. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
